description: Maps each equippable cursed-tool/object/extras item's VariableId to its equipment grade and the ordered list of equipment-effect rows that define its gameplay bonuses.

Id.technical: FName row key. Equipment lookups do not use the owning Item row's Id: they resolve FGameDataTableRow_Item::VariableId across all EquipmentItemDataTables and find this row by that name. Exported IDs include a base ID plus _10/_20 suffixed upgraded variants. The first matching table wins; a missing row yields no effects.

Grade.technical: int32 with constructor default 0; exported rows use 0, 1, and 2, matching base and two upgraded ID suffixes. No identified C++ consumer reads this field in the available Source, so the precise gameplay or sorting effect of each grade is not established.

Id_EquipmentItemEffect.simple: Ordered list of effect rows applied by this equipment variant.
Id_EquipmentItemEffect.technical: TArray<FName>. Battle setup walks the array, skips None entries, resolves each effect ID in EquipmentItemEffectDataTables (first matching table), and adds the effect rows to the status-controller effect list. Item description uses the same array at index 0 and 1 to populate two description lines, returning an empty request for an invalid index or None entry. The status controller also keeps an effect-index counter used for one-use item consumption.

notes: The export contains 211 rows. Multiple table shards are supported and consumers stop at the first matching row per table array, so duplicate IDs across shards can shadow later rows.

This table is a thin join: ItemDataTable::VariableId points here, and this table's effect-name array points into EquipmentItemEffectDataTable. Item text and battle stat calculations both rely on that chain.
No source consumer for Grade was found; only its serialized type/default and the exported 0/1/2 pattern are evidence. Do not infer an exact grade bonus from the number alone.
Only the supplied retail export and partial Content are available; no claim is made about all Blueprint or editor-tool uses.

usages.detail: GameEquipment_GetEffectRows resolves an Item's VariableId to this row, then resolves every named effect row for battle stat setup.
Revives once-only equipment effects from the player's equipped Item IDs, keyed by effect array index.
Finds the effect at a requested description index for cursed tools, cursed objects, and extras.
